answer: Give every identity a reputation balance that decays like saffron dye fading in sunlight and can only be topped up by peer-verified completed work. Each economic action burns a slice of that balance, so influence must be continuously earned, never bought in bulk. A Sybil farmer can mint a thousand identities, but each starts at zero and only gains spending power through real work; idle fakes rot away, and flooding the ocean of transactions costs more verified labor than it returns. Even a whisper of coordination among fakes is useless without earned balance to act on.
